nodes.description: SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): adds two unsigned integers and requires the result to be >= a to detect overflow.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): requires b <= a then subtracts, guarding against underflow.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): multiplies and requires a == 0 || c / a == b to detect overflow.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): requires b > 0 before dividing.
Owned() constructor: sets owner = msg.sender, giving the deployer privileged control.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner: stages a new owner address.
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred and finalises ownership transfer.
BlackPyramid() constructor: initialises symbol, name, decimals, total supply and pre-funds the deployer address.
totalSupply() constant: returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with an unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant: returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] to tokens and emits Approval.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): spends allowance via safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract (external call).
Fallback function payable that unconditionally reverts, refusing ETH.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: external call to ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).
address public owner: privileged address of the Owned base contract.
address public newOwner: pending owner used in the two-step ownership transfer.
string public symbol: token ticker 'BLPD'.
string public name: token name 'BlackPyramid'.
uint8 public decimals: token decimals (18).
uint public _totalSupply: total token supply.
mapping(address => uint) balances: per-account token balances.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed: ERC20 allowances.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after the allowance write, enabling reentrancy by an untrusted spender contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an owner-supplied, untrusted token contract.
Unchecked arithmetic ' _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] ' with no overflow/underflow guard.
onlyOwner modifier guard 'require(msg.sender == owner)' protecting privileged functions.
Access-control check require(msg.sender == newOwner) before ownership is transferred.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for balances, allowances, ownership and owner checks.
